checks.message: PASS means the provisional source and limitation are explicitly declared and machine-readable; it does not certify an official redline or precise area. Eligible for conceptual content review only.

PASS means submitted concept polygons are structurally reviewable over provisional geometry; spatial confidence remains low and no statutory control is asserted.
